description: Dated events of the named operators in operator-attributions.json, one row per event, for the model's operator event blocks. happened_at is when the event took place, as precise as known: a UTC instant, a day or a month. evidence_public_at is the earliest UTC time at which public evidence of the event can be shown: on chain, on a dated web capture, or when a page was read. A forecast from an origin may schedule an event only when its evidence_public_at is on or before the origin (forecast_use schedulable). An event with no public evidence before it happened is record-only: it stays in the history the model is fitted and scored on, and no forecast schedules it. Counts come from the dataset runs named in data_runs.

events.subject: avax10f8305248c0wsfsdempdtpx7lpkc30vwzl9y9q
events.statement: GoGoPool's first validator stake paying its reward address, the start of the evidence that groups its decisions
events.evidence_note: On chain from the stake itself

events.subject: avax10f8305248c0wsfsdempdtpx7lpkc30vwzl9y9q
events.statement: GoGoPool stops funding the validators it ran directly from its liquid staking pool. Its active nodes fall from 381 at the end of 2025-07-31 to 114 at the end of 2025-08-31, and to 35 at the end of 2025
events.evidence_note: No announcement or public reason was found. Each node's last period end was on chain from its stake, but not that it would not renew

events.subject: avax10f8305248c0wsfsdempdtpx7lpkc30vwzl9y9q
events.statement: gogopool.com says the GoGoPool brand will move to Hypha over the next few months
events.evidence_note: The earliest archived capture found that carries the notice. An earlier capture, 2026-02-10, was not checked for it

events.subject: avax10f8305248c0wsfsdempdtpx7lpkc30vwzl9y9q
events.statement: GoGoPool's protocol support ends: no new minipools, and stAVAX stops earning. One GoGoPool node is active on that day, and its last new commitment started on 2026-06-16
events.evidence_note: The end-of-life page states the date in the future tense, so it was published before 2026-08-15 and after the 2026-03-06 capture. No archived copy dates it. 2026-09-29 is when it was read here, the earliest date that can be shown

events.subject: avax10f8305248c0wsfsdempdtpx7lpkc30vwzl9y9q
events.statement: The end-of-life site closes. Holders must withdraw before this date
events.evidence_note: Same page and reading as NE4

events.statement: The sAVAX contract grants BENQI's key ROLE_DEPOSIT at 12:22:21 UTC (block 10,079,793) and ROLE_WITHDRAW at 12:22:42 UTC (block 10,079,804). Neither role is revoked later. The key's only revoked role is ROLE_ACCRUE_REWARDS, on 2024-03-25
events.evidence_note: RoleGranted and RoleRevoked events of 0x2b2C81e08f1Af8835a78Bb2A90AE924ACE0eA4bE for account 0x565f0fe9715e3cb0df579f186c299d6707887e83

events.subject: avax19zfygxaf59stehzedhxjesads0p5jdvfeedal0
events.statement: BENQI's first delegation. Every one of the 5,962,350 delegations its key funded before 2025-11-19 16:00 UTC names this address as its only reward owner
events.evidence_note: On chain from the delegation. Funding is the address with the largest share of a delegation's staked UTXOs, as in primary-delegator-stakes. Reward owners are the delegations' reward_addresses in the same P_TRANSACTIONS table

events.subject: avax1dwkwval9epuwxpy0g2m6xg2l00fx4yxtzah80t
events.statement: The address holds a mainnet genesis allocation, so it is known from launch. Its first validator stake is on 2020-10-29

events.subject: avax1dwkwval9epuwxpy0g2m6xg2l00fx4yxtzah80t
events.statement: The holder starts a fleet of 82 nodes at exactly 2,000 AVAX each, the first on 2025-06-19. Every period of the fleet ends by 2025-08-01 15:00 UTC, and each end is on chain from its stake

events.subject: avax1dwkwval9epuwxpy0g2m6xg2l00fx4yxtzah80t
events.statement: The fleet's last periods end on 2025-08-01 and none renews. The holder then delegates to validators run by others: 164,540 AVAX in two delegations on 2025-08-29 and 64,844 AVAX on 2025-09-14
events.evidence_note: No announcement was found. That the fleet would not renew was not public before it happened
